dataset.name: CaptainCook4D
dataset.license_or_access_note: CaptainCook4D annotations are MIT licensed; local 360P videos are retained for research screening under the upstream dataset terms.

observed_events.description: The wearer takes a loose line from a dental-floss dispenser and attempts to cut the food roll by pulling the line with both hands; the knife is already nearby.
The wearer takes the blue-handled kitchen knife and cuts that same roll into separate pieces.

screening.proposed_instruction: Could you add a spare of what I use to get this cut done?
screening.source_continuity: Continuous 582.2–621.2 s of the same original recording; one opening request and no cut in replay.

supported_claims.text: A loose line from a white dental-floss dispenser is held and pulled across the roll while a blue-handled knife is on the board.
The same roll is cut into pieces with the hand-held kitchen knife; it is the tool that completes the cut.

construct.research_question: When the wearer changes how they finish one ongoing activity, can an agent revoke an early choice that no longer matches the requested tool?
construct.belief_before: Ordinary long loose dental floss being tried is a reasonable provisional choice, while the available hand knife is also plausible.
construct.belief_after: The line attempt does not visibly separate a piece. A kitchen knife finishes the same cut.
construct.required_behavior_change: Remove any floss selected earlier and leave one eligible complete kitchen knife. A correct knife already selected may remain.
construct.no_update_failure: Leave only the provisional spool in the cart, or select another physical cutting method not used to complete this cut.
construct.overupdate_failure: Add a knife while leaving the provisional spool or another extra item in the cart.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The same request and site expose multiple plausible cutting methods. The source shows which method actually separates pieces.

task_blueprint.instruction: Could you add a spare of what I use to get this cut done?

observed.why: The line is being tried on the roll and the knife on the board remains a plausible way to finish.
The wearer switches to the kitchen knife to cut the same roll; following frames confirm separate pieces.
